column1: # AIO Feeder hub — 16 MB flash. App sits at 0x10000 so the web-flash layout
# M8a (v0.11.0): otadata + two OTA slots + a 256 KB "badapp" data partition
# reverts to the last valid slot if a new image never confirms.
# M8b (v0.12.0): OTA slots trimmed 4.75 → 4.25 MB to make room for "nfw" —
# the node-firmware store the dashboard uploads into and /fw/node serves to
# nodes (§7.6). One-time hub re-flash (or one self-OTA hop) after upgrading.
